author: gpt-5.6-luna
kind: ticket export (CSV, 200 to 260 tickets) for a 5-team product launch, plus roadmap.md, team-capacity.csv, holidays.csv, last week's status note and a short README explaining the export columns
scenario: A director writes: the payments-and-checkout launch slipped, write the status for leadership this week. The export has columns such as id, title, epic, team, assignee, status, estimate_points, sprint, depends_on, created, due. Sprints are two weeks. The roadmap names a launch date that is no longer reachable.
seeds: (1) a buried critical-path dependency: a small, unassigned or low-priority ticket in another team (for example a certificate, vendor sandbox or schema-migration ticket) that the longest dependency chain to launch runs through, reachable only by following depends_on two or three hops; (2) a date conflict: a ticket whose due date is earlier than the due date of a ticket it depends on; (3) one person whose assigned open points in the next sprint exceed their capacity after holidays by a clear margin; (4) scope creep: tickets added to a launch epic after the scope-lock date in roadmap.md, with their total points; (5) one decoy: a ticket marked blocked whose blocker is already done, so it is not a real risk. Last week's status note says green and misses all of this. Also put in the data, for a later finance task on the same export: a few tickets with a blank estimate, one ticket that was closed and then reopened (a status-history or reopened column shows it), and one assignee whose name appears in two spellings (case or a trailing space).
shape: {"overall": "green|amber|red", "risks": [{"tickets": [ids], "kind": "critical-path|date-conflict|over-allocation|scope-creep|other", "summary": str, "owner": str}], "critical_path": [ticket ids from first to launch], "revised_launch_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reasoning": {"remaining_points_on_critical_path": n, "team_velocity_points_per_sprint": n, "sprints_needed": n}, "capacity_by_sprint": {"<sprint name>": points}, "scope_added_after_lock_points": n}
